title: Rules
description: Verdicts, tags and change priorities set once and applied to every scan, past and future.
intro: A rule sets a value wherever it matches: it ignores or escalates vulnerabilities, triages and tags services, marks what did not change as reviewed, or mutes and re-rates changes. Rules never overwrite what a user set, the first matching rule in the order wins, and what a rule set goes back once it no longer matches.
empty: No rules yet. Start from a template.
deleteDescription: Delete “{{name}}”? What it set goes back to unreviewed (or to the next matching rule) and the tags it added are removed. Values users set stay.

vulnerability.name: Vulnerabilities
vulnerability.description: Sets the triage of matching vulnerabilities of services: ignore them (false positive, accepted risk) or mark them important.

service.name: Services and applications
service.description: Sets the triage of matching services (or of their hosts) and/or adds a tag.

unchanged.name: No change
unchanged.description: Sets the triage of services (or hosts) that did not change in the latest scans. Once one changes, the value goes back to unreviewed.

change_priority.name: Change priority
change_priority.description: Mutes or re-rates matching changes between two scans in the dashboard and the change export.

preview.title: What it would do now
preview.invalid: Complete the rule to see what it would do.
preview.counts: Matches {{matched}}: would change {{changes}}, already set {{unchanged}}, left as they are {{skipped}}.
preview.scan: Checked on the newest scan with results ({{date}}).
preview.skippedHint: Left as they are: a user set them, or a rule earlier in the order already does.

form.description: The rule applies to every scan as soon as it is saved, and again after every new scan.
form.presetHint: Fills in the form; change anything before saving.
form.name: Name
form.nameInvalid: Give the rule a name (at most 100 characters).
form.scopeHint: Every filled-in field must match; empty fields match anything.
form.listHint: Separated by commas; any of them
form.productsHint: Part of the service name or product, e.g. nginx, OpenSSH
form.vulnerabilityIdsHint: One or more ids; empty = any vulnerability
form.scansHint: 1 to {{max}}; each scan compared with the one before it
form.tagHint: Removed again when the rule no longer matches
form.readTimeHint: Applied whenever changes are read, so it also covers past scans; nothing is stored.
form.ownershipHint: Only values that are unreviewed or were set by a rule change. A user's own verdict always stays.
form.expiresHint: Optional; afterwards what the rule set goes back

ignoreCve.name: Ignore a CVE on an application
ignoreCve.description: A known vulnerability the team accepted on this software inside the internal network.

ignoreBackports.name: Ignore uncertain distribution matches
ignoreBackports.description: Potential matches on distribution packages whose fix may be backported without a version change.

lowSeverity.name: Accept low-severity findings in the lab
lowSeverity.description: Vulnerabilities with a CVSS score below 4 on hosts tagged lab.

escalateKev.name: Escalate known exploited vulnerabilities
escalateKev.description: Anything in the CISA KEV catalog is important.

unchangedReviewed.name: Unchanged services are reviewed
unchangedReviewed.description: A service that did not change in the last two scans needs no new look; it goes back to unreviewed when it changes.

muteCertRotation.name: Mute certificate rotation
muteCertRotation.description: Renewed certificates (new certificate, issuer or expiry) are routine.

muteUnstable.name: Mute blips of unstable hosts
muteUnstable.description: Unstable hosts that went quiet or did not answer are noise, not findings.

riskyPortHigh.name: Remote access opening is high
riskyPortHigh.description: A new Telnet, SMB, RDP or VNC port is always high priority.

adminPanels.name: Admin panels are important
adminPanels.description: Services whose page title points at an admin or login panel.

tagDatabases.name: Tag databases
tagDatabases.description: Database ports get the database tag.
